name: Asai F. Lavinia
source:
Asai F. Lavinia is [url=/c1537]Ryou’s[/url] partner in protecting [url=/c1538]Sion[/url]. She’s quite cheerful and carefree on the surface, but she of the same rank as Ryou, having been through many battlefields to get there. Unlike Ryou, however, she specializes in close range combat with blades, and has a special love for swords.

[Edited from [url=http://calamitousintents.wordpress.com/2009/12/28/review-eden-they-were-only-two-on-the-planet/]Choux's review[/url].]
